children: A software system that takes instructions, breaks them into steps, interacts with external systems, makes decisions along the way, and completes workflows without human input at each stage.
How does an AI agent differ from a chatbot?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-2917d6e e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: A chatbot handles conversation. An AI agent executes tasks. It interacts with external systems, makes decisions across multiple steps, and completes workflows autonomously. If you need AI to do something rather than say something, you need an agent.
How much does AI agent development cost?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-df71506 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: A single-task agent starts from $30K. A multi-agent system with complex orchestration typically ranges from $80K to $200K and above. The precise number is defined in the Discovery Sprint.
How long does it take to build an AI agent?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-dbc0ba6 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: An agent MVP takes 8 to 12 weeks. A full multi-agent system takes 3 to 6 months, depending on scope, data readiness, and integration complexity.
Can AI agents integrate with existing enterprise systems?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-31f046d e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: Yes. We connect agents to CRM, ERP, databases, SaaS platforms, and internal APIs. Integration architecture is defined in Discovery before development begins.
What AI agent frameworks do you build with?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-d951992 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, CrewAI, HuggingFace Transformers, PyTorch, and TensorFlow, among others. Framework selection is made in Discovery based on your specific agent requirements.
Can AI agents learn and adapt over time?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-574c00f e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: Yes. We implement machine learning and adaptive logic so agents continuously improve decision-making accuracy and optimise performance based on real operational data over time.
How do you ensure AI agent reliability and security?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-0a4c208 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: Through rigorous testing, SOC 2 and GDPR compliant architecture, and post-launch monitoring with MLflow that detects drift and triggers retraining when performance degrades.
